title: page:tabs sums a related list hidden by its own visibleWhen into the tab badge, so a tab reads 「概览 1」 over a list nobody can see
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2916 dev report (cloud PR #3035, report `6254151626`), out-of-scope finding 2. ⛔ Not a claim.

## What a user sees (measured)

On a local stack at objectui `43efd078`, Chromium, zh-CN, the environment page's 「概览」 tab drew 「概览 1」 on a free-plan environment with no installed app. The one counted list was the domains related list, which its own `visibleWhen` hides on the free plan.

Cloud PR #3035 sets `count: 0` on that tab as a local workaround.

## Why (objectui `43efd078`)

- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` `collectRelatedLists` (`:525-555`) walks every related list under a tab without reading `visibleWhen`.
- The badge comes from `computeCount` (`:858`) and is drawn above 0 (`:959`).

## Target

The derived tab count skips a related list whose `visibleWhen` is false for the viewer, as the renderer itself does when it draws the tab's body.

## Acceptance

A test: a `page:tabs` item with one related list hidden by `visibleWhen` and one shown counts only the shown list's rows.

## Dedupe

Searched for: `page tabs derived count hidden related list`, `tab badge visibleWhen`.
